title: WhatsApp agent
description: The workbench's own WhatsApp account (a second number, not the owner's): household members write to it as to their own CO chat; other saved contacts and groups that call it get an isolated agent (only web search; no files, shell, devices, MCP, CLAUDE.md or the owner's dossier) that speaks without the owner only on the owner's instruction or about the owner's affairs and otherwise asks the owner's permission; it writes first when the owner asks. The account runs as a linked device in a browser on the home PC (whatsapp-web.js, unofficial: WhatsApp may ban the number). It can also write the server's pushes to the household members who turned that on (config --pushes).
isolationReason: a WhatsApp Web session needs a browser on the home PC

data.server: state/modules/whatsapp/pushes.json: copies of pushes of the envs whose WhatsApp service asked for them (at most 300, 24 h)
data.home: %LOCALAPPDATA%/AIWorkbench/wa-agent (session of the linked device, inbox, events, config.json with the chat id)
